issues.message: hashicorp/azurerm before 4.9 has no features.storage.data_plane_available, so storage accounts reach for data-plane hosts the sandbox can't resolve: 4.x hangs creating them, 3.x fails retrieving their static website properties

hashicorp/google before 7.26 keeps the API version in request paths built from http custom endpoints, so creating Cloud SQL databases fails on the local emulator (HTTP 400 "uploadId is required"); Nimbo points Cloud SQL instances and users, project IAM, Service Usage and GKE at emulator roots so those still work
oracle/oci 9.3 and newer call the Functions API version 20260325, which floci-oci (0.5.0) doesn't serve: creating functions applications fails locally (404)
issues.fix: To deploy functions in the sandbox pin version = "9.2.0" (the newest release that calls Functions API 20181201; Nimbo validates against the newer schema, so attributes added later are unavailable), or deploy them on OCI only
